result.title: Learning inadequacy of Bayesian neural operators for PDE-constrained inference and design
result.summary: Partial differential equations (PDEs) underpin predictive modeling across science, engineering and medicine. Their use in digital twins, parameter inference and optimal design requires repeated solutions across parameters and scenarios. For nonlinear, transient and multiphysics systems, these calculations can make numerical simulation prohibitively expensive. Here we introduce the residual-informed Bayesian neural operator (RI-BNO), which learns operator inadequacy using a posteriori error estimates from the governing PDEs and incorporates its correction and uncertainty into Bayesian training and prediction. We establish local error bounds for the residual-informed estimates under stability and smoothness assumptions. We demonstrate RI-BNO on a non-linear reaction-diffusion benchmark with DeepONet and latent-subspace architectures, Markov chain Monte Carlo inference of glioma parameter fields from magnetic resonance imaging, and Monte Carlo risk-averse optimization of three-dimensional thermal breaks in building envelopes under manufacturing uncertainty. Across the evaluated examples, RI-BNO improves agreement with finite element (FE) reference predictions, parameter posteriors and optimized designs while using half as many full nonlinear or transient training simulations as the vanilla Bayesian neural operator (vBNO). For thermal break design, online optimization time decreases from 178 hours with the FE model to 18 minutes with RI-BNO. These results demonstrate the value of explicit inadequacy modeling in neural operators for reliable PDE-based inference and design.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 residual-informed Bayesian neural operator（RI-BNO），用 PDE 的 a posteriori 残差误差估计显式学习算子模型的不足，并把该修正与不确定性并入 Bayesian 训练与预测，在反应扩散基准、基于 MRI 的胶质瘤参数 MCMC 推断和三维热桥风险规避设计中验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式建模模型不足并给出局部误差界」的做法，可能与 LVR 中依据自估误差决定是否继续计算或补充证据（LOOK/STOP）以及 latent 状态中不确定性表达有概念上的呼应，但属跨领域线索，可供核查迁移可行性。
